protocol.procedure: Analyze public failure logs to detect oscillation patterns and coverage gaps. Prioritize deadline violations. Generate a branch-and-dispatch workflow that dynamically routes tasks using diagnostic signals and preserves memory of optimal paths and failures.

parent.procedure: Use public failure evidence to propose one reusable branch-and-dispatch workflow. Respect the DSL grammar.
